title: No-tile window is 91 days; sort, search and empty states
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in, on the build under test, as a service advisor with the view customers and create and edit customers permissions. Raising a work order also needs create and edit work orders.
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab.
  3. Enough rows to scroll: a schedule "Worklist load" with three services, "W30" (Every 30 days), "W60" (Every 60 days) and "W90" (Every 90 days); bulk-enrol all 22 assets of one customer on it with blank last service dates (customer Assets tab > Enroll in Schedule > Select all > Enroll 22 assets). That gives 22 × 3 = 66 rows, all due within 91 days.
  4. One more service on that schedule, "W120" (Every 120 days), so each asset also has a row due beyond 91 days.
  5. For step 5: a second organization on the environment with nothing enrolled, and one where every enrolled service is due more than 91 days out; if the environment has none, mark step 5 Blocked with that reason.
custom_steps:
1. With no tile active, look for the W120 rows and the W30, W60 and W90 rows.
  2. Read the default order of the rows; then click the Asset, Customer, Service and Due column headers in turn.
  3. Search by a unit number, a VIN, the customer name and a service name (e.g. "W60").
  4. Activate the Overdue tile and search for a term matching nothing (e.g. "zzz"); read the table, then press Clear filters.
  5. In the second organizations, open the tab with nothing enrolled, and with nothing inside the window.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • W30, W60 and W90 rows are listed (due within 91 days); the W120 rows are not.
  • The rows are sorted by due date, oldest first, then by unit; Asset, Customer, Service and Due each sort from their header.
  • Each search narrows the rows and the tiles to the matches (e.g. "W60" leaves only W60 rows).
  • The table reads "No reminders match" with Clear filters; Clear filters clears the tile, the chip, the location filter and the search.
  • With nothing enrolled the tab says there are no maintenance reminders yet; with nothing inside the window the time tiles read 0 and the table says nothing is due in the next three months.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780, story SV-10570 (S13, The maintenance reminders worklist), Chunk 1 MR (Confluence 886931488) as edited 5 October 2026, S13 (S13-R33, S13-R36, S13-R37); Plan 1 — Track, act, clear — Technical Implementation Plan, section 6 Phase P7, worklist empty states; read 6 Oct 2026. Source-verified 6 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R36: “With no tile active the list shows every row that is overdue, due today or due within the next 91 days, plus every Needs readings row whatever its date. A service further out is not listed”
  • S13-R37: “sorted by due date, oldest first, then by unit. Asset, customer, service and due are sortable by their column header”
  • S13-R37: “Search matches unit number, VIN, customer and service name, and narrows the tiles as the location filter does”
  • S13-R33: “With a tile, filter or search active and nothing matching, the table reads No reminders match, with Clear filters”
  • Plan 1 §6 P7 empty states: “Clear filters (clears tiles, chip, location, and the shared search)”
  • S13-R33: “Where nothing is enrolled, the tab says there are no maintenance reminders yet. Where assets are enrolled but nothing falls inside the list's window, the time tiles read zero and the table says nothing is due in the next three months”
